Both remain weakly grounded—the cited Nb-silicide studies do not establish that Sn alone will form an adherent protective scale in equiatomic HfNbTaTiZr and explicitly report unresolved synergy and scale-spallation issues—but B’s narrower, lower-Sn intervention is more testable and less likely to disrupt mechanical performance.
